article.headline: Etchison’s 24 help IU Indianapolis down UT Martin 75-74
article.description: — Gus Etchison’s 24 points helped IU Indianapolis defeat UT Martin 75-74 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Etchison’s 24 help IU Indianapolis down UT Martin 75-74

categories.description: UT Martin Skyhawks @ IU Indianapolis Jaguars

event.description: UT Martin Skyhawks @ IU Indianapolis Jaguars

keywords: UT Martin Skyhawks @ IU Indianapolis Jaguars
article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Gus Etchison’s 24 points helped IU Indianapolis defeat UT Martin 75-74 on Saturday. Etchison shot 9 for 16, including 4 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Jaguars (2-0). Kameron Tinsley scored 16 points while going 4 of 11 from the floor, including 4 for 9 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the line, and added six rebounds. Davi Remagen led the way for the Skyhawks (0-2) with 19 points. UT Martin also got 14 points from Vladimir Khryapa. Up next IU Indianapolis has a matchup Wednesday with Southern Indiana at home. UT Martin visits Arkansas State on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
